notes_for_editor: Thin record: the sources give a 1930s camp and abandonment, nothing on staffing, fires or access, so those are left out. Record longitude -115.86751 differs from the Association list's -116.12445 (about 19 km apart); latitudes agree within about 100 m. Check the point before relying on it. Corrections proposed for kind (unknown to camp) and status (gone to abandoned). Story is 120 words, at the floor, because the sources say little more.
